body.name: Calendar-varying finite-memory RIPW class
body.construction: \(\mathcal M(T,p,\mathcal S,\epsilon)\) is the set of tuples \((P,\Pi,\mu,m,\tau)\) such that \(\mathcal S\subseteq\{0,1\}^{T}\) is finite and nonempty, \(\Pi_s\geq\epsilon\) for every \(s\in\mathcal S\), \(\pi_s(X)\geq c_{\pi}\) almost surely for every \(s\in\mathcal S\), consistency and pathwise conditional mean random assignment hold, \(\mu_t(s,X)=m_t(X)+\sum_{\ell=0}^{p}\tau_{t,\ell}(X)(D_s)_{t,\ell}\) for every \(s\) and \(t\), and \(G(\Pi)\succ0\).
